desc: The Boki base's playthings (GARDEN.md section 4; only while farm_build.json base_mode is on). A Boki at home with a joy below joy_below picks a toy on its own, walks to it, plays play_secs and gains one point of the toy's stat (Care.add_stat, capped by level as today) and joy. Each toy has the clip a rigged Boki plays at it (BokiHomeClips, set as the kact meta). Units: seconds, tiles, 0..1 trait values, joy points.
join_weight_doc: A toy someone is already playing with is this many times likelier, so a second Boki tends to join in.
